title: Creator Brain — Round 2 Approved Content Strategy

objectives.content_mix: Strategic balance of educational content, project promotion and personal branding, with education and credibility as the leading tone.
objectives.video_production: Natural smartphone-recorded videos with minimal editing; no dependence on professional cameras, drones, expensive post-production or complicated shoots.
prohibitions: Generic luxury clichés and repetitive property advertisements
Complex filming workflows requiring professional equipment
Unverified claims about pricing, payments, investment returns, amenities or delivery
objectives.primary_success: Build trust, authority, lasting personal branding and perceived professional competence ahead of short-term sales pressure.
permitted_topics: Agent firsthand experience and useful professional observations
Market insights, qualified with sources when factual

editorial_voice.positioning: Agents should sound like front-line insiders and experienced real estate professionals sharing useful firsthand expertise, not interchangeable sales representatives.
avoid: Unsupported expertise or fabricated firsthand experience
editorial_voice.teaching: Provide credible perspectives, useful buyer questions, tradeoffs, comparisons, local context and explanations of why details matter. Ask what the agent actually knows or has observed rather than inventing personal experiences.
editorial_voice.creative_decisions: Prefer buyer-focused value hooks, authenticity, practical smartphone shooting, and long-term reputation. Promotional content may include an appropriate CTA, but do not let a sales pitch dominate the video.
editorial_voice.language_dependency: Apply Round 1 natural English and Qatar-appropriate Arabic dialogue and script requirements.

pass_when: Offers a useful insight or takeaway
Sounds credible as a practicing real estate advisor
Is feasible to shoot casually on a phone
Keeps claims factual and within available knowledge
Contributes to trust and personal authority
revise_when: Only lists project amenities or payment offers
Opens with a weak generic property advertisement
Requires advanced production for no clear gain
Sounds formulaic or unrelated to the agent's real experience

implementation_note: Approved training specification persisted for later application. Saving this file alone does not change the deployed agent's behavior; integrate into its conversation rules and evaluate bilingual responses before describing it as trained.
